faq.q: What does the Introduction to Structural Drying Concepts course cover?
faq.a: It covers the science of how buildings respond to moisture, how drying dynamics operate in real structures, how to monitor drying progress accurately, what equipment systems are available and how they work together, and what standards define successful completion.

courseJsonLd.name: Introduction to Structural Drying Concepts
courseJsonLd.description: This course introduces water damage restoration technicians to the foundational concepts that underpin all structural drying work. It covers the science of how buildings respond to moisture, how drying dynamics operate in real structures, how to monitor drying progress accurately, what equipment systems are available and how they work together, and what standards define successful completion. Every module is directly applicable to job site decision-making. Content is aligned with the IICRC S500 Standard for Professional Water Damage Restoration and Australian WHS requirements.
